# Narrative

## Product
Tinyinvoice: invoices for freelancers that get paid on time. (Demo project, not a real product.)

## Audience
Solo freelancers and two-person studios who send 5 to 30 invoices a month.

## Problem
Chasing payments takes longer than doing the work, and invoicing tools are built for accountants.

## Origin
I freelanced for six years and spent a day each month on invoices.

## Stage
beta

## Milestones
- [ ] 100 paying users

## Voice
casual, technical when it helps. Never "excited to announce", never "game-changer".

## Platforms
X, LinkedIn

## Off-limits
- Acme Corp

## Arc so far
- Opened the beta to 40 freelancers.
